_label: DECLARED field equivalences. Every entry was asserted by a person and carries its basis. Nothing here was inferred by similarity.

equivalences.asserted_by: OP5-CINDER, from reading both lanes' data dictionaries
equivalences.basis: Both fields hold the item's position in a priority ordering, and both use a distinct marker rather than a number when the item is not ranked. uiowa_rfq_18649_prioritization/DATA_DICTIONARY.md defines 'rank' as null/NOT_RANKED when unranked; the opportunity portfolio's 'rank' is the same concept. The equivalence is asserted on the documented meaning, not on the shared name.
